intro: Hyacinth Mushrooms are distinctive fungi found sprouting at the roots of trees throughout Shadowglen on Teldrassil. Prized by local night elf herbalists for their medicinal properties, they also happen to be favored food and forage for the mischievous grell and grellkin.

p: Hyacinth Mushrooms grow abundantly across Shadowglen, flourishing in the damp shadows at the bases of trees, mossy stones, and the sprawling roots of Aldrassil. While useful in woodland remedies, they have also caught the attention of the corrupted grell, who frequently hoard them. When young night elf sentinels or trainees are afflicted by local venomous fauna—such as the spiders of Shadowthread Cave—these mushrooms serve as a core component in soothing draughts and antivenoms concocted by forest healers.
